ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigations and arrests related to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and explore the larger pattern of fraud in the state.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are investigators working to prevent and detect fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of fraud and corruption, and could lead to significant reforms in the way that Medicaid is administered in Minnesota.
